import RNA, random, sys
target='....((((((((....((..(...................)..(((...((....))...((....))........))).......))))))))))....'

def score(seq):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq)
    ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
    d=RNA.bp_distance(ss,target)
    e=fc.eval_structure(target)
    return d, mfe-e, ss

# warm starts: my best near-miss + random
warm='AAAAGGGUGGGGCAAAGGAGCAAAACAAAAAGAAAAAGAAGCAGCGGAAGCGAAAGCAAAGAGAAAUCAAAAAAGACGCAAUAAUACCCCCCACCCAUAA'

mutable=[i for i,c in enumerate(target) if c=='.']

best=None; bd=999; bpe=999
import time
t0=time.time()
random.seed(7)

# Strategy: random-restart hill climb on mutable positions, score = (bp_dist, mfe-target_energy)
restart=0
while time.time()-t0 < 150:
    if restart==0:
        cur=list(warm)
    else:
        cur=['.']*100
        # init from structure: pairs G-C, unpaired A
        st=[]
        for i,c in enumerate(target):
            if c=='(': st.append(i)
            elif c==')':
                j=st.pop(); cur[j]='G'; cur[i]='C'
            else:
                cur[i]=random.choice('ACGU')
    cd,cpe,css=score(''.join(cur))
    # local climb
    improved=True
    while improved and time.time()-t0<150:
        improved=False
        # try mutating each mutable position to each base
        order=mutable[:]; random.shuffle(order)
        for p in order:
            orig=cur[p]
            bestb=orig; bestsc=(cd,cpe)
            for b in 'ACGU':
                if b==orig: continue
                cur[p]=b
                nd,npe,_=score(''.join(cur))
                if (nd,npe)<bestsc:
                    bestsc=(nd,npe); bestb=b; improved=True
            cur[p]=bestb
            if bestsc[0]<cd or (bestsc[0]==cd and bestsc[1]<cpe):
                cd,cpe=bestsc
            if cd==0: break
        if cd==0: break
    if cd<bd or (cd==bd and cpe<bpe):
        bd=cd; bpe=cpe; best=''.join(cur)
        sys.stdout.write('restart %d bd=%d pe=%.2f t=%.0f %s\n'%(restart,bd,bpe,time.time()-t0,best)); sys.stdout.flush()
    if bd==0:
        sys.stdout.write('SOLVED\n'); sys.stdout.flush()
        break
    restart+=1

sys.stdout.write('FINAL bd=%d %s\n'%(bd,best)); sys.stdout.flush()
